page.layout: One page of text, single column of verse lines; running head at top with page number at top right. Faint show-through from the reverse page throughout; no margin notes.

main_text.p: Hoc candens sublime, tegit quod cuncta, liquenti
Crystallo veluti lamina ducta nitens,
Est speculi sensum nunquam fallentis adinstar,
Mens vbi te clare, sit nisi caeca, videt.
Sed te præcipue Solis fax ignea monstrat,
Qui, Solus quod sit, non male nomen habet.
Teque Deum clamat, non de quampluribus vnum,
Sed solum: cui par, cui sociumque nihil.
Teque Deum Dominumq; suum veneratur & audit,
Dum quod vis iussus noctè dieque facis.
Vno te celebrat surgénsqu�• cubánsque tenore,
Non verbis, sed te rebus vbique loquens.
Illum Maurus, Arabs intelligit, Indus vterque,
Thrax, Scyta, Germanus, Sarmata, Gallus, Iber.
Quod facit ille tacens, sanċti facitote loquentes:
Dum facit impietas quod scelerata facit.
Non etenim penitus desit Titania pubes,
Aufa Deum contra tollere dira caput.
Scire cupis quid sit componere Pelion Offa?
Qualia sunt, eheu! tempora nostra vide.
Crimina criminibus cumulantur: pectore pulsus
Euanescit amor numinis atque metus.
Excipe perpaucos, Pietatis & excipe nomen:
Vix vbi sit pietas posse notare datur.
Pellit enim Solem caligo prophana diemque:
Hinc sceleram furgunt agmina densa simul.
Propterea poenas cœlo pendere minantur,
Hinc aër, illinc Terra Fretúmque graues.
At tu Iustitiæ Sol, qui, vitalibus alis
Æternæ solus dona salutis habes:
Sol, clypeúsque tegens sis nobis, Christe, calente
Noxa die ne sit Solis vt vlla grauis.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page is present throughout and was not transcribed. Several words are doubtful due to faint printing and ink bleed; "sanċti" and "Offa?" (possibly Offæ with a mark), "Teque Deum clamat" and "Titania" are uncertain. The line "Vno te celebrat surgénsqu�• cubánsque" has an unclear mark after "surgénsque" and should be checked. Some letters are overprinted by stains.
